messages.subject: Stray .RData files on glimmer.rstudio.com
parts:
We found a bug today on the Shiny hosting service (glimmer.rstudio.com) where .RData files were being created when Shiny Server asks R processes to exit prematurely (for example, when we are taking the server down to upgrade to a newer version of the software). Although usually this is harmless since ShinyApps tend not to put stuff in the global environment, I know of at least two cases where this has already caused problems.

If you'd like to purge all .RData files from your glimmer account's ShinyApps directory, please execute the following command either at an ssh prompt, or in RStudio Server under Tools | Shell.

find ~/ShinyApps -name .RData -exec rm {} +

Note that this command doesn't distinguish between .RData files that were created due to this bug, and meaningful .RData files that you put there on purpose. So if you have .RData files that matter, please rename them temporarily or something.

Sorry for the inconvenience!
